title: Direct goal manipulation through the unauthenticated admin goals endpoint
summary: The agent's objectives are replaced for every later invoice from every vendor until someone resets the configuration. High-value invoices are approved for payment without review.

LC.rationale: Attacker-supplied natural language is posted directly to the unauthenticated admin goals endpoint and is appended unvalidated into the privileged system prompt that drives tool invocation.

CP.rationale: The injected goals are stored durably in the FinBotConfig row in the database and injected into the system prompt of every later invoice run, persisting beyond the originating session.

AP.rationale: Compromised goals influence the single FinBot agent and its tools within the same application and policy domain; no other agent, tenant, or principal is involved.

RH.rationale: The agent's tool loop can reach the proxy signal (approve_invoice, which awards CTF flags and completes the reward path), but no human-verified reward-hacking episode is documented in the packet.

ES.rationale: The agent has five fixed tools defined in code with no dynamic tools, MCP servers, plugins, or skills on the assessed path.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The lab models FinBot as an autonomous invoice-processing agent whose goals are natural language injected into the system prompt and whose approval decisions are model-selected tool calls.
